articles.text: CHICO: Estoy pensando irme a trabajar a los Estados Unidos.
CHICO: I'm thinking of going to work in the United States.
LUIS: Está bien, pero en ese caso necesitas visa de inmigrante.
LUIS: That's fine, but in that case you need an immigrant visa.
CHICO: Yo no, yo soy americano.
CHICO: Not me, I'm an American.
LUIS: Oh, yeah? Since when are you an American?
CHICO: Desde que nací. Yo nací en los Estados Unidos.
CHICO: Since I was born. I was born in the United States.
LUIS: No sabía. Creía que era una broma.
LUIS: I didn't know. I thought it was a joke.
